doc.markdown:
Cryptographic printable tokens from the explicit system random capability.
Current tokens contain twenty-six independent alphabet symbols, or 130 bits
of entropy. The secure default may grow to maintain at least 128 bits.
No seed, replay state or mutable global source is exposed.
